products.title: Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau De Parfum is a fresh and aromatic perfume for men. Launched in 2023, it opens with a burst of fruity and citrus notes of apple, Italian lemon, Sicilian bergamot and star anise. The middle contains majesty plum, orange blossom and cardamom, giving a sweet and spicy impression, while the base leaves a warm musk, amber, driftwood and moss trail that is long lasting.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Eau De Parfum For Men
products.body_html: Hawas for Him by Rasasi is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Hawas for Him was launched in 2015. Top notes are Apple, Bergamot, Lemon and Cinnamon; middle notes are Watery Notes, Plum, Cardamom and Orange Blossom; base notes are Ambergris, Musk, Patchouli and Driftwood.

products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa Eau de Parfum is a sweet, spicy and creamy scent made for both men and women. This perfume brings together the cozy warmth of cinnamon and cardamom with the smooth sweetness of praline and vanilla. The mix of coffee and tonka bean gives it a deep, rich aroma that feels comforting yet classy. It’s a perfect scent for people who love strong, dessert like perfumes with a warm base that stays beautifully on the skin.

products.title: Afnan 9pm Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9pm Eau de Parfum is one of the most admired amber vanilla fragrances for men, launched in 2020. The scent is a popular choice amongst fragrance enthusiasts, one sharing similarity with Jean Paul Gaultier’s Ultra Male. The perfume’s bold and seductive composition featuring a rich blend of sweet, spicy and warm notes makes it ideal for evening wear, romantic date nights and cooler seasons of the year.

products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum is a warm, spicy, and irresistibly sweet unisex fragrance that is an oriental charm with a modern twist. Known for its rich cinnamon and vanilla profile, Khamrah is a bold scent inspired by Arabian traditions and global luxury tastes. Often compared to high-end niche perfumes, Lattafa Khamrah offers an affordable alternative without compromising on quality or performance. This perfume is ideal for people who enjoy strong, lasting fragrances with a warm, dessert-like aroma.

products.title: French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and woody men’s perfume for those who enjoy creamy, cozy scents. Launched in 2024, this perfume opens with spicy, fresh notes of cinnamon, cardamom, bergamot and soft orange blossom. The middle is smooth, creamy, and tastes of bourbon, vanilla, elemi and has a soothing impression. It has a deep and addictive base with praline, ambroxan, guaiac wood and musk that leave a sweet woody scent that is modern and bold, yet most of all wearable.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Collectors Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is a modern, fresh, and classy men’s fragrance that brings confidence with every spray. Inspired by timeless elegance, this scent mixes fruity freshness with warm woody notes, making it perfect for the man who wants to stand out.

The first spray greets you with a burst of juicy pineapple, crisp apple, and fresh bergamot balanced with delicate white flowers. As it settles, you’ll notice the heart of orange blossom, smooth birch, and warm amber adding depth and richness. The dry-down is where Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum shines earthy oak moss, clean musk, and unique ambergris, leaving a long-lasting, masculine trail that people won’t forget.

Whether you’re dressing up for a special event or adding a touch of class to your daily look, Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is your perfect companion.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Blue Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Turathi Blue is a crisp, fresh, and uplifting scent crafted for the modern man. It starts with a burst of zesty bergamot and mandarin, creating an energizing first impression. The scent then drifts into warm amber, entwined with woody nuances, before finally resting on a base of smooth musk and patchouli with a touch of spice. Ideal for everyday wear, it is both refined and approachable with a touch of Middle Eastern richness.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Eau de Parfum is a bold and rich fragrance for men from the house of Lattafa. Launched in 2021, it is a perfect mix of spicy, woody, and sweet notes. The top notes of black pepper, tobacco, and pineapple give it a fresh yet spicy start. The heart combines patchouli, coffee, and iris for a warm and smooth feel. The base of vanilla, amber, dry wood, benzoin, and labdanum makes it linger on skin with a deep, oriental touch.

products.title: Lattafa Nebras Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Nebras Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm and cozy unisex scent that feels like a creamy vanilla dessert with a soft fruity touch on top. It opens with juicy red berries and a fresh mandarin orange. In the middle the main characters are smooth vanilla, cacao with a trace of soft rose. With the last notes of sugar, tonka bean amber, and clean musk make the base turn warm and welcoming.

products.title: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by Afnan Perfumes. It was created by perfumer Gaël Montero it is a fruity-aromatic scent with a playful yet classy touch. The perfume opens with juicy pineapple, fresh green apple and sweet mandarin (top notes). The middle notes combine creamy vanilla, oakmoss and cedarwood for a smooth balance. Finally, the base leaves a warm trail of ambergris, dry woods, caramel and musk that lingers beautifully.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Black Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Black Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance from the house of Rasasi. Launched in 2024, this scent feels fresh, fruity and woody at the same time. It starts with delightful pineapple, vibrant bergamot and tangy grapefruit, which give a clean and energetic feeling. The middle of the fragrance already shows patchouli, cedar and a hint of jasmine, making the perfume slightly rich and slowly earthy. The strong and warm base is made up of oakmoss, woody notes and amber that linger on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Afnan Rare Reef Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Rare Reef Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, fruity and aromatic unisex perfume from the Afnan house. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels bright, juicy and smooth at the same time. It opens with a burst of citrus and fresh mint that feels clean and energetic. As it settles, soft fruity and floral notes come out, giving it a calm and slightly sweet touch. The base feels warm and cozy with fig, amberwood and dates, making the scent balanced and easy to wear.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger with You Intensely Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Intensely EDP is the one you grab when you're head-over-heels and want the world to know. Starts with a sharp pink pepper snap, a whiff of juniper, and this powdery violet that sneaks in soft, then melts into toffee, cinnamon, lavender, and sage for a sweet-herbal swirl. Vanilla, amber, tonka bean, and suede close it out warm, leathery, and addictive. Dropped in 2019, it’s the bolder chapter in the Stronger With You story, all about young passion. We bet on the caramel-spice combo, cozy enough for cuddles, sexy enough to stop traffic, hangs around all night and leaves folks sniffing your collar.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Bourbon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Bourbon Eau de Parfum is a modern and wealthy oriental spicy perfume for men. The scent is warm, deep, and bold, and it is suitable for men who love strong and powerful scents. Lavender is fresh, mirabelle is juicy and pink pepper adds a small kick at the very beginning of the fragrance. The heart is cacao, nutmeg, and davana mixed; dark and rich, giving a sweet but spicy feel. The dry down consists of vanilla, amber, and vetiver which are smooth and thick thus making it creamy, manly, and comforting at the same time.

products.title: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau de Parfum is a fresh, sweet and somewhat spicy perfume that suits both the women and men. It starts with an appetising blend of mango and lemon that is refreshing and cheerful, and it is spiced a little by ginger. Tones become light and sweet as it subsides with floral notes of praline such as jasmine and violet. Tonka bean, woods and moss make the base warm and smooth and thus comfortable and lasting. This smell is contemporary, comfortable, and very satisfying.

products.title: Rayhaan Lion Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Lion Eau de Parfum is a bold, fresh, spicy aromatic perfume for men who like strong yet smooth perfumes. Released in 2024, it opens with a fresh mix of lavender, pear, mint and bergamot, which feels clean and slightly sweet. The heart comes with warm spices like cinnamon and cumin blended with herbal clary sage. The base dries down to a creamy, cozy blend of vanilla, amber, cedar and patchouli, giving a masculine, confident vibe.

products.title: Afnan  Modest Une Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Modest Une Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance that was launched in 2019. It is an aromatic spicy combination made for men who like fresh, bold and long-lasting perfumes. The opening comes with sharp pepper, soothing lavender, cool mint and spicy nutmeg. The middle notes bring citrus, warm amber and refreshing eucalyptus. The base is masculine with musk, vetiver and cedarwood giving it depth and strength that stays for hours.

products.title: Lattafa Najdia Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Najdia Eau De Parfum is a fresh and bright unisex scent that mixes citrus, light spices, soft woods and clean watery notes. It opens with a sharp hit of lemon, bergamot, cinnamon, apple and lemongrass that gives an instant fresh-spicy feeling. Then the heart brings refreshing watery notes, lavender, rosemary and cardamom that make the scent clean, cool and smooth. Finally, the base gets all warm and cozy with musk, amber, sandalwood, cedar and a slight touch of tobacco which adds a gentle depth to the perfume without making it too heavy.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Imagination Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Imagination Eau De Parfum is a bright and modern citrus aromatic scent made for men who like fresh, clean and a bit warm type perfumes. The aroma begins with a silky blend of citron, bergamot, and orange, then transitions to soft neroli, spicy ginger, and cinnamon which feels warm but still fresh. The lower notes are stronger with Chinese black tea, ambroxan, guaiac wood, and olibanum that remain on the skin for a long time and impart a luxurious and soothing aura.

products.title: Afnan 9PM Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9PM Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern unisex fragrance from the house of Afnan. Launched in 2025, this perfume is rich, warm and slightly spicy with a smooth, sweet touch. It starts with powerful spicy notes that are lively and strong, then gradually transitions to a soft heart of leather and lavender. The vanilla and patchouli base at the end creates a milky, warm and soothing feeling. Afnan 9PM Elixir Eau de Parfum feels classy but is still easy to wear.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men is a fresh, modern, and confident fragrance that balances crisp freshness with deep woody notes. Inspired by the spirit of the contemporary man who dares to dream, this scent embodies boldness, freedom, and a touch of class.

The opening is refreshing, featuring juicy apple, spicy ginger, and zesty bergamot. In the heart, Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men brings aromatic sage, vibrant geranium, and juniper berries, giving it a green yet slightly floral twist. The base notes wrap you in warm amberwood, smooth tonka bean, rich cedar, vetiver, and olibanum, creating a long-lasting masculine trail.

Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men is perfect for those who love versatile, everyday scents with a signature edge. One spray is enough to make you feel fresh, stylish, and ready to conquer your day.

products.title: Lattafa Fakhar Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Fakhar Men Eau De Parfum is a rich oriental scent made for confident men who love strong, fresh and woody notes. Launched in 2022, this perfume opens with bright and spicy touches of apple, bergamot and ginger. The heart consists of a soft and smooth mix of lavender, sage, juniper berries and geranium that is cool yet masculine. The tonka bean, amberwood and vetiver make a powerful, warm and woody base that lasts for hours.

products.title: Riiffs Momento Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Momento Extrait de Parfum is a new unisex scent launched in 2025. Riiffs Momento Extrait de Parfum is a warm, sweet and woody fragrance with a little spicy touch. The scent opens with sugar, saffron and fresh mandarin, giving a sweet and slightly citrus start. In the middle, you get soft tonka bean, romantic Damask rose and creamy agarwood. The base is deep and smooth with amberwood, caramel and cedar, which gives a creamy, woody drydown.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Eau De Parfum for Men, launched in 2019, is a modern, contemporary take on the classic Davidoff Cool Water DNA. It is a perfect mix of the zestiness of green mandarin as the top note, the creaminess of the coconut water as the heart note, and the warmth of amber as the base note. Cool Water Intense EDP came out as a way to enjoy a classic warm-weather, island-inspired fragrance without breaking your pocket.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau de Parfum is a fresh, bright and modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2025, this fragrance opens with juicy and citrusy notes that feel clean and energetic. As it settles, soft florals and fruity tones come out, making it smooth and pleasant. The warmth of musk, amber and vanilla in the base gives the perfume a balanced, easy everyday fragrance.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a fresh and clean fragrance for men. It makes one experience of a cool ocean breeze on a hot, sunny day. It was launched in 2017. The Eau De Parfum begins with a sweet burst of grapefruit scent along with mandarin orange. The heart tones are surrounded by the warm musk  and amberwood smell. The soft and confident smell makes you effortlessly attractive on any day.

products.title: Lattafa Badee al Oud Honor & Glory Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Honor & Glory Eau de Parfum is a unisex Arabic perfume that combines creamy, spicy and woody notes into one smooth scent. The opening is a delightful combination of pineapple and creme brulee, which feels both sweet and warm. When it settles down, the middle reveals the spices of cinnamon, turmeric, black pepper, and the sweetness of benzoin, making a heart that is both spicy and cozy. The dry-down is soft and rich with the notes of vanilla, sandalwood, cashmeran, and moss, which give the perfume a permanent warmth.

products.title: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum is a bright, fresh, and modern unisex fragrance that mixes juicy citrus with smooth woods and soft musk. Inspired by sunny days and easy elegance, this perfume opens with a splash of zesty Sicilian lemon, refreshing bergamot, and a hint of spicy black currant. As it settles, fruity notes blend with soft jasmine and earthy patchouli leaf, adding depth and charm. The dry-down is warm and creamy with cedar, leather, vanilla, and white musk that stay on your skin for hours.

Mancera Cedrat Boise is a perfect everyday fragrance for people who love fresh, energetic scents with a classy twist. It feels youthful yet sophisticated, making it a favourite for both men and women who want to smell fresh, clean, and stylish all day long.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Oud for Glory Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Oud for Glory Eau De Parfum is a strong and deep Arabic perfume made for both men and women who love rich oud scents. It starts with spicy and warm notes of saffron, nutmeg, and lavender, which make the fragrance bold right from the beginning. The main part of the perfume features soft patchouli and burnt agarwood (oud) giving the scent a dark and classy character. At last, the base of agarwood, patchouli, and musk come together in a very organic way, leaving behind a warm and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Parfum
products.body_html: Le Male Elixir Parfum is a warm, sweet and spicy take on the classic Le Male. It opens with fresh lavender and cool mint, then turns creamy with vanilla and benzoin in the middle, and settles into a cosy base of honey, tonka and tobacco. It feels rich, a bit sexy, perfect for evenings and cooler days, and stays close to the skin with a soft, warm trail.

products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Dukhan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Dukhan Eau de Parfum is a creamy oriental scent for men from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. Launched in 2025, it combines smoky, spicy and sweet notes that wrap around you like warm air. It begins with the spiciness of pimento and the freshness of mandarin, and then goes to deep incense, labdanum and orange blossom. The base contains soft praline, tobacco, amber and tonka bean which result in a smooth and creamy finish.

products.title: Lattafa Teriaq Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Teriaq Intense Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet, spicy scent made for both men and women. It opens with a unique combination of saffron and bright bergamot, then develops through a smooth heart of plum liquor and cinnamon to a deep base of amber, tonka bean and benzoin. The perfume is daring but gentle at the same time leaving a warm, cozy vibe which is long-lasting on the skin.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Intense Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Intense is a sweet, fresh, and bold men’s perfume that feels active and very strong. The first impression is of a rich pear fragrance completed by lavender, mint, bergamot and lemon, which together provide a fresh and a little bit sweet beginning. There are warm cinnamon and clary sage that together give a spicy and smooth feeling. The bottom notes include the very strong vanilla, amber, patchouli, and cedar, which leave a very long-lasting impression on skin. It conveys confidence, youthfulness, and is suitable for men who prefer sweet yet strong perfumes.

products.title: Ajmal Kuro Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Kuro is designed for the modern Indian gent who wants the punch of a designer perfume without the designer price tag. The first spray bursts open with cool bergamot and lively pepper, giving a crisp “wake‑up” feel that cuts through humidity. Just seconds later, elegant French lavender and bright geranium step in, smoothing the edges and adding a clean, shirt‑fresh vibe. Deeper down, earthy vetiver, patchouli, and a whisper of ambergris ground the scent and help it cling to skin and fabric long after sundown. Think of it as a confident handshake that turns into an all‑day friendship, easy to like, hard to forget, and perfect for the office, college campus, or a late‑night drive.

products.title: Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is a bold, fresh, and sensual men’s fragrance inspired by the Greek god of love Eros. Just like its name, this perfume is all about passion and power. It opens with an amazing blast of mint, sweet candy apple, and zesty citrus fruits. As it settles, warm ambroxan and fresh geranium add depth and masculinity. Finally, a smooth blend of vanilla, cedar, and leather wraps you in a warm, confident finish.

Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is perfect for modern men who want to feel strong, attractive, and unforgettable. A few sprays will boost your confidence and turn heads wherever you go.

products.title: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau De Parfum is a calm, woody, and comforting unisex fragrance that brings to mind the peaceful beauty of sandalwood forests. Inspired by the mountains of Tonkin in Vietnam, this perfume is a tribute to sacred woods and age-old traditions. Tam Dao is simple yet rich, perfect for those who love warm, woody, and smooth scents with a soft floral base. Tam Dao is ideal for people who prefer minimalism in scent – smooth, clean, and soothing.

products.title: Afnan Historic Sahara Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Sahara Eau de Parfum is a warm and sweet unisex perfume from the house of Afnan. Launched in 2025, this scent feels rich, cozy and a little spicy. The opening is very fresh and spicy due to the presence of cardamom, cinnamon and bergamot. The middle is very comforting and sweet with vanilla, sugar and elemi. The base makes one feel deep and pleased with praline, almond, tonka, musk and ambroxan. It is a smooth oriental vanilla scent that feels modern but still has that desert warmth vibe.

products.title: Khadlaj Island Dreams Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Island Dreams Extrait de Parfum is a cool and warm oriental perfume that is aimed at both women and men. It begins with a spicy ginger touch combined with bright bergamot, which is a clean and slightly sharp beginning. The heart then soon introduces a juicy feel of grapefruit that adds freshness. Musk and ambroxan base enable it to be smooth, soft, and long-lasting on the skin. It is contemporary, elegant, and comfortable.

products.title: Lattafa Vintage Radio Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Vintage Radio Eau de Parfum is an unisex scent that can be characterized as warm oriental-woody with an opening that is soft, smoky and fresh. It starts with lavender, sage, and bergamot on the top, goes into a dark and sweet mixture of plum, palo santo, and black pepper in the heart and finishes with a smooth base of sandalwood and oud.

products.title: Nusuk Al Mukhtalif Signature Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Al Mukhtalif Signature Extrait de Parfum is a decadent and bold men’s fragrance from the house of Nusuk. Released in 2024, it brings a deep woody aromatic scent style with a strong Middle Eastern touch. The scent opens with a powerful mix of oud, sandalwood, rose, amber, bergamot, neroli and jasmine, which feels warm and slightly fresh at the same time. The middle blends agarwood, patchouli, cedar, lemon, rose and jasmine, giving it a woody floral depth. The base settles into smooth oud, musk and vanilla, leaving a soft, sweet, woody trail that feels classy and long lasting.

products.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum is an impressive, smooth, and elegant leather fragrance which has a rich and profound character. It starts with the spicy touch of cardamom, which is at once fresh and a little warm. In no time, strong leather notes along with soft jasmine give a powerful yet clean impression. Deep and long-lasting scent is achieved by the combination of amber, moss, and patchouli at the base. The fragrance strikes as being steadfast, contemporary, and fashionably, ideal for those who appreciate powerful and elegant scents.

products.title: Nautica Voyage Man Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage Eau De Toilette for men is a fresh, clean and easy-going fragrance from the house of Nautica. It is made for daily wear and feels light, cool and relaxing. The scent opens with crisp green leaves and juicy apple that feels very fresh on first spray. The heart of the fragrance introduces the very gentle floral notes of lotus and mimosa that provide a creamy and watery sensation. Finally, musk, cedar, oakmoss and amber round up the scent’s drying process, making it a very clean but to a great extent still gentle and pleasant woody base on the skin.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Oros Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Oros Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, floral and woody perfume for women who like creamy, warm scents. It opens with nutty hazelnut mixed with coffee and a light citrus peel touch. The heart brings a white floral feel with tuberose, rose water and soft florals. The drydown becomes cozy and sweet with vanilla, cocoa, musk, cinnamon and cedarwood.

products.title: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. Its launch in 2024 revealed the mixture of spicy, citrus, and woody notes in a fresh and elegant perfume. The composition starts with the lively cardamom, ginger, bergamot, and lemon that serve the energetic and clean opening. Lavender, geranium, and mint form the middle, with their soft, herbal, and calming touch added to the composition. The base is composed of amber, cedarwood, patchouli, and vetiver that create a warm and smooth long-lasting dry down on skin.

products.title: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume that gives a bold and confident vibe. Launched in 2023 by the house of Lattafa, it brings a fresh and spicy mix that feels both clean and deep. The perfume opens with juicy apple, spicy cardamom and fresh bergamot. The middle notes brings in warm tobacco, lavender and floral geranium. The dry-down is rich with tonka bean, leather, vetiver and patchouli.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau de Parfum is an appealing, sophisticated, and intense fragrance that is suitable for men during the evening. The top note is a soft and smooth burst of bergamot which is quickly replaced by the combination of creamy and powdery iris note alongside roasted chestnut in the heart. The base note consists of the likes of whiskey, wood, and amber which makes the overall feel sweet, boozy, and warm. The scent gives out luxury, elegance, and romance. Besides, it is an ideal fragrance for the cold nights, dinners, dates, and other romantic occasions.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette is a classic men’s perfume known for its cool, fresh and confident vibe. Launched in 1988, it’s still a favorite for those who love clean and ocean-like scents. It starts with a mix of mint, green notes, lavender and rosemary, giving a crisp freshness, then brings soft hints of sandalwood, jasmine, and geranium. Finally, the base adds depth with musk, cedar, ambergris and tobacco, making it long lasting, masculine and refreshing all day.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum is a strong and sweet scent for men that gives a feeling of luxury and elegance. The spicy opening with cumin and cardamom is rich and a bit refreshing at the same time. Little by little, the gentle rose and powdery orris appear and smoothen out the fragrance. Finally, vanilla, amber, and woods create a soft and very persistent end. This perfume is strong, masculine, and an ideal choice for the self-assured man.

products.title: Lattafa Ramz Silver Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ramz Silver Eau De Parfum is a smooth and modern unisex scent that opens fresh and sweet at the same time. It starts with juicy pear, soft lavender, cool mint and bright bergamot. The heart brings warm cardamom and clean sage. The dry-down is rich and cosy with vanilla, amber, musk and patchouli.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Tropical Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Tropical Eau de Parfum is a fresh, tropical scent for men who like cool, green, slightly sweet perfumes. Launched in 2025, this scent opens with juicy coconut water, green fig leaf and spicy ginger, which gives it a lively start. The middle features creamy coconut, fresh fig and mint, making it feel breezy and clean. The base is soft and warm with sandalwood, tonka bean and musk, creating a smooth tropical trail that smells modern and relaxed at the same time.

products.title: Khadlaj Island Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Island Extrait de Parfum is a women's and men's perfume, a fruity woody fragrance. Island was launched in 2024. The ingredients include Pineapple, Iris, Ginger and Cypress as the top notes, Coconut and Woodsy Notes as middle notes and Tonka, Sandalwood, Amber and Ambergris as the base notes.

products.title: Afnan 9PM Night Out Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9PM Night Out Extrait de Parfum is a bold, modern scent for nighttime and special outings. It is sweet, warm and a little spicy, which makes it very attractive and easy to notice. The opening feels fruity and slightly boozy with a smooth mix of pitahaya, apple and a touch of cognac. As it settles, it becomes creamier and softer, with notes of toffee and suede. In the dry down, it turns deep, warm and long lasting with tonka bean, patchouli and woody notes.

products.title: Khadlaj Cloud Candy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Khadlaj Cloud Candy Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy perfume by Khadlaj Perfumes, targeted at both men and women. It is released in 2025 and provides a soft, candy-like touch with a warm and cosy feel. Cloud Candy begins on a sweet and light note that is almost fluffy, as though sugar is melting in the air. 


The heart becomes creamier and smoother after a couple of minutes, which resembles the sensation of a candy shop. When it fades, it becomes warmer and softer, keeping close to the skin in a warm and cosy sweetness. It is light-hearted, light, and somewhat addictive and is ideal for those who enjoy sweet smells that are not heavy but are easy to detect.

products.title: Lattafa The Kingdom Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa The Kingdom Eau de Parfum is a new aromatic perfume made for men who like fresh, sweet and warm scent all in one bottle. It opens with soft lavender, mint and sage that give a clean start. Then the scent turns a bit sweet and creamy with vanilla, tobacco and orange blossom in the heart. Later on, the warm base of tonka, benzoin, and labdanum comes in, making it smooth, sweet and a little bit smoky.

products.title: Rayhaan Obsidian Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Obsidian Eau De Parfum is a bold and dark woody perfume for men who like strong yet smooth scents. It opens with soft iris and fresh citrus notes, giving a clean, slightly powdery start. As the scent settles, the leather note comes forward, giving a deep, masculine feel. In the drydown, warm notes of sandalwood, ambrette, cedar and oud create a creamy, woody base that feels elegant and long lasting. Rayhaan Obsidian is simple but powerful, a fragrance that suits modern men who enjoy warm, woody and leathery scents.

products.title: Riiffs Golden Elixir Reserve Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Golden Elixir Reserve Eau de Parfum is a creamy and warm unisex perfume from Riiffs Perfumes. Launched in 2024, it is a sweet, spicy scent profile built with cinnamon, cognac, cardamom and coffee in the opening; praline, dates and tonka bean in the heart and a deep base of vanilla, agarwood and musk.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Platinum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Platinum Eau de Parfum is a fresh woody aromatic scent made for both men and women. It opens with bright citrus notes of lemon zest and orange that feel clean and lively. The heart comes with soft white tea and green fig leaf which gives a smooth and calming vibe. The base is warm and slightly musky with amberwood, cedar, and musk, making the scent feel elegant but still easy to wear daily.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim Eau De Parfum is a bright, juicy and refreshing citrus scent made for people who love clean and energetic summer perfumes. It opens with a strong blast of mandarin and orange that feels like fresh sunshine on skin. The bergamot adds a soft sparkle, while ginger and ambergris give it a warm, salty, slightly sweet twist that dries down clean.

products.title: Afnan 9AM Dive Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9AM Dive Eau de Parfum is a fresh aquatic fragrance for both men and women that was Launched in 2022 it brings a cooling and energising feel that is perfect for warm days. The perfume starts with bright lemon, mint, black currant and pink pepper (top notes). In the middle, it turns smooth with apple, cedar and incense. The base carries ginger, sandalwood, patchouli and jasmine creating a balanced, refreshing yet slightly woody scent.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is an elegant oriental fragrance for both men and women. Inspired by rich Arabic traditions and royal gatherings, this scent wraps you in warmth, sweetness, and a soft floral touch.

Bin Shaikh combines the beauty of fresh roses, exotic saffron, and earthy oak moss with a sweet heart of bakhoor, sugar, jasmine, and violet. The dry down is deep and comforting with oud, amber, ambroxan, musk, and patchouli creating a luxurious trail.

Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is perfect for those who love sweet, woody scents with a hint of floral freshness. Just a few sprays make you feel confident, royal, and ready for any special moment.

products.title: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum is a fresh and spicy scent made specially for men. It opens bright with lemon, iris, and vervain, giving a citrusy and green start. The middle notes move into lavender, violet, and some spicy touches that make it elegant and smooth. At the base, ambergris and sandalwood bring depth and warmth, making it a timeless perfume that feels both clean and classy.

products.title: Riiffs Freeze Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Freeze Extrait De Parfum is a fresh, cool and slightly citrusy fragrance, launched in 2025. It opens with a blast of lemon zest, bergamot and grapefruit mixed with mint, giving a very icy and refreshing feel. There is also a unique “snow” accord which makes it feel extra cold and clean. In the middle, ginger and tea add a light spicy and aromatic touch. In the dry down, amber, cedar and peony give a smooth, soft and slightly woody base.

products.title: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow Eau de Parfum is a bold, oriental, spicy male perfume that opens fresh and slightly sharp, featuring notes of grapefruit and pink pepper. A clean touch is added by lavender, followed by warmth and richness from amber and cedarwood. Patchouli, moss and musk are used in the dry down to form an even, long-lasting dark base. It is powerful, contemporary and suitable for self-confident men who prefer luxurious evening perfumes.

products.title: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette is a fresh and strong men’s fragrance that feels clean, modern, and confident. It opens with a cool splash of bergamot, grapefruit, and watery notes that feel very fresh on skin. Slowly, it moves into a spicy and slightly woody heart with black pepper and ambroxan. The base feels warm and smooth with musk, incense, and tonka bean. This scent feels masculine, stylish, and perfect for daily wear.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Blue Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Blue Oud Eau de Parfum is a deep and strong fragrance that combines rich oud with soft floral notes. It starts with a smooth combination of oud and blue lilies, giving a fresh yet dark feeling. The middle becomes warm with leather and patchouli, adding a bold touch. In the last, you get sweet amber and smoky tobacco, which make the scent feel cosy, elegant, and long-lasting. It is a beautiful combination of luxury and softness, suitable for both men and women.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and bold unisex perfume. It has a deep oriental-woody feel with a sweet top and smoky base. The scent opens with pineapple and saffron, then moves into balsam fir and soft jasmine in the heart. The dry-down is thick, warm and long-lasting with cedar, amber and oud.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Red Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Red Eau de Parfum is a bold and energetic perfume for men. Launched in 2020, it opens with fresh and fruity top notes of apple, lavender and bergamot. The combination of juicy watermelon, warm cedar and spicy calamus, while the base gives a rich finish with amber, sandalwood and patchouli. It is a modern scent that balances fruity freshness with woody warmth, perfect for everyday wear or special occasions.

products.title: Calvin Klein Ck One Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein CK One Eau de Toilette is one of the most famous unisex perfume in the world which was launched in 1994 it brings a fresh and clean vibe that feels natural on both men and women. The Fragrance starts with citrus fruits like lemon, bergamot and mandarin orange, mixed with pineapple, green notes, cardamom and papaya and the middle brings a soft floral touch with jasmine, violet, rose, freesia, lily of the valley, nutmeg and orris root. The base is warm and balanced with green tea, sandalwood, musk, cedar, oakmoss, amber and green accords. CK One is simple, cool and made for everyday wear.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey Dubai Chocolate Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Dubai Chocolate Eau de Parfum is an opulent, luscious, and sugary fragrance that comes across as a dessert in a container. A warm combination of coffee, pistachio, and praline comes first that is both delicious and inviting. With a very light spiciness of cardamom, next come the cocoa butter and gentle vanilla. The last stage consists of caramel and tonka which making it even smoother, cozier, and more durable. This fragrance feels like hugging, is very contemporary, and is extremely hard to resist.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Fire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Fire Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern unisex fragrance from Rasasi. Launched in 2025, it is an aromatic aquatic scent that combines natural green and floral tones with warm and deep base notes. The fragrance's opening is very relaxed with fresh Clary Sage, then Egyptian Jasmine and Marine notes blossom in the middle and finally, Amber, Mineral notes and Ambergris compose a warm base.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold, warm and slightly spicy oriental fragrance made for men, launched in 2025. It opens with a sharp mix of pink pepper, saffron and grapefruit, giving a fresh yet spicy kick. As it settles, tobacco, vanilla and cedar add a deep, smoky sweetness with a woody touch. In the dry down, amber, frankincense, patchouli and cashmeran create a rich, smooth and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy, unisex perfume from Paris Corner fragrances. Launched in 2023, it carries a bold oriental scent style built with black pepper, elemi and pink pepper in the opening; olibanum and saffron in the heart; and a smooth base of vanilla and cedarwood.

products.title: Lattafa Atheeri Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Atheeri Lattafa Perfumes is a floral oriental perfume for women. This is a new fragrance. Atheeri was launched in 2025. Passion Flower and Dew Drop are the highest notes; Orchid and Jasmine are the middle notes; Vanilla and Amberwood are the lowest notes. The first impression is light and fresh with a touch of water and a flowery fragrance, but gradually, it becomes warm and smooth in the heart. The base has vanilla and amberwood that provide a warm, though slightly sweet taste that lingers for hours later. It suits well those female customers who prefer floral perfumes with a soft, warm touch.

products.title: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum is a bold leather perfume for men launched in 2020 by the house of Afnan Perfumes. It carries a strong masculine edge with an elegant combination of spicy, floral, woody and smoky accords. The opening is sharp and intense with leather, violet leaf, nutmeg and cinnamon. The middle brings floral tones of violet and rose combined with deep oud and cedar wood. The dry down is warm, earthy and rich with vetiver, sandalwood and amber giving it a timeless Arabic touch.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette is one of the most talked-about scents in the men’s fragrance world which was released in 2015 it has a sharp, fresh and bold profile that combines fruity, floral and woody notes in one bottle. The perfume starts with a blast of lemon, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple giving a citrusy yet sweet start. The middle slowly brings in smoky birch, soft jasmine and gentle rose. The endnotes are smooth and long-lasting with musk, ambergris, patchouli and a touch of vanilla which adds warmth and depth.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blu Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2024, it is a bold take on a fresh and woody DNA profile consisting of leather, bergamot, and cypress (top notes); geranium and violet leaf (heart notes); and agarwood, patchouli, and musk (base notes) mixed seamlessly into a smooth composition with classic Middle Eastern accords of oud, incense, and guaiac wood.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum is a unisex fragrance launched in 2020. It is a bright and fresh perfume that opens with citrus and fruity notes of bergamot, lemon, black currant, lime, violet leaf, and ginger. The middle notes are soft florals like rose, iris, and jasmine and the final notes settle into a classy combination of ambroxan, musk, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a fragrance that feels clean, modern, and versatile, perfect for everyday wear or special evenings.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica By The Fireplace Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica By The Fireplace Eau De Toilette is a warm and cozy unisex fragrance that gives the soft, smoky feeling of sitting close to a wooden fire on a cold winter night. It starts with a combination of spicy cloves and pink pepper, then moves to sweet chestnut and smooth woods in the middle and finally ends with a mellow, creamy base of vanilla, Peru balsam and cashmeran.

products.title: Rue Broca Theoreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Théoreme Eau de Parfum is a fresh, warm perfume for men, and simultaneously clean, spicy and smooth. It plays out with bright citrus that provides a sharp and energetic opening. Gradually, the amber and woody tones appear, bringing the warmth and richness. The musk, spices and patchouli in the dry down leave a strong and lasting trail. It is contemporary, secure and comfortable.

products.title: Lattafa Najdia Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Najdia Intense Eau de Parfum is a fresh and powerful men’s fragrance that feels vibrant and modern. The first impression is juicy pineapple and apple that bring a sweet, fruity kick, then slowly mint and ginger add a cool, spicy freshness. As it settles, marine notes and lavender give a clean feel, while tonka bean and sandalwood in the base create a smooth, warm finish that lasts for hours.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Ombre Nomade Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Ombre Nomade Eau De Parfum is a dark, rich and deep unisex perfume. It is known for its strong oud, smoky incense and warm amber wood feel that stays long on the skin. The scent opens with a mix of sweet raspberry and saffron, then melts into rose and smoky incense and finally settles into heavy agarwood that gives a strong touch.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum is a unisex floriental fragrance by the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house launched in 2023. It is a beautiful and graceful balance of numerous scent notes, which could have given messy results without fine blending. Marj has oud, honey, pink pepper, elemi, nutmeg, bergamot, and mandarin for its top layer; jasmine, cashmere wood, vetiver, orange blossom, cinnamon, patchouli, and saffron for the heart; and musk, ambergris, raspberry, oakmoss, saffron, pear, amber, agarwood, sandalwood, leather, and violet for the base of the composition.

products.title: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum was launched in 2013 by Ajmal fragrance house that is based in UAE as a fresh aquatic scent with a touch of citric and floral notes. It opens with Citric bergamot, flowery lavender and fruity watermelon; with time it diffuses off the top notes and the heart notes of Lotus and jasmine becomes more prominent and finally it has a soft and musky drydown with its amber, musk and sandalwood notes.

products.title: Lattafa Liam Grey Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Liam Grey Eau de Parfum is a classy and modern unisex fragrance that brings together warmth and freshness in a very balanced way. Launched in 2023, it’s a mix of spicy cardamom, sweet fig and rich black tea at the top. The heart opens with soft iris, vetiver and labdanum, giving a smooth and deep texture. The dry down is warm and creamy with vanilla, sandalwood, tonka and patchouli. It feels elegant and calm, perfect for daily wear or evening outings.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Soul of Bali Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Soul of Bali Extrait de Parfum is a tropical and spicy unisex scent that feels fresh, warm, and smooth. It opens with juicy mango, pineapple, rhubarb, and bergamot with a little ginger and pink pepper spice. The heart brings saffron, cardamom, and soft woody tones, while the base of ambergris, sandalwood, musk, and cypriol gives it a long-lasting warm finish. It is classy, bold, and easy to wear for many occasions.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Iconic Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Blue Iconic Eau de Parfum is a fragrance for men that gives a combination of fresh, spicy and woody notes which was launched in 2022 it opens with a bright and zesty combination of grapefruit, lemon, mint, pink pepper and coriander. The middle notes are ginger, melon, nutmeg and jasmine adding a warm yet fresh touch. In the end you will find woody notes, incense, sandalwood, amber, cedar, patchouli and labdanum which together create a masculine finish.

products.title: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau De Parfum is an exquisite and elegant unisex fragrance that has a woody character. It is warm and soft, and very luxurious, right from the first application. The fragrance starts off with delicate spices and rosewood that are both clean and rich. Gradually, the oud and sandalwood appear, creating a profound woody sensation. During the dry down, tonka bean and amber provide a gentle and prolonged sweetness. This perfume feels luxurious, serene, and self-assured, ideal for the customers of high-end fragrances.

products.title: Jaguar Classic Black Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jaguar Classic Black Eau De Toilette is a smooth, fresh, and slightly warm men’s fragrance that combines fruits, spices, and deep woody notes. It opens with crisp apple and bright citrus that feel clean and sharp. In the middle, you get tea, sea breeze notes, and soft spices that give a cool and calming vibe. The base is warm with musk, cedarwood, sandalwood, and tonka bean, making it soft, sweet, and classy. It is a simple, everyday masculine scent that feels modern, clean, and comforting.

products.title: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep scent for men. It’s a warm oriental-woody perfume that mixes spicy, sweet and smoky tones beautifully. The fragrance opens with cinnamon, lavender and mandarin for a spicy-fresh start. The middle brings soft iris, cypress, benzoin and floral mahonial. The base settles into creamy vanilla, tonka, amber, incense, cedarwood and patchouli giving a rich and warm trail.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum is a bold, aromatic fragrance made for men who love rich, smoky, and spicy scents. This perfume mixes fresh herbs, warm spices, deep resins, and dark woods to create a unique scent that feels powerful and masculine.

Inspired by the mystery of smoky incense burning in a grand hall, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum wraps you in layers of fresh bergamot, spicy oregano, and herbal notes. As it settles, the heart opens with opoponax, warm amber, and labdanum that add a smooth sweetness. Finally, the base brings strong smoky notes, oud, leather, and earthy patchouli that stay on your skin for hours.

If you want to stand out at any party, wedding, or special dinner, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum will make sure you get noticed for your bold and classy taste.

products.title: Khadlaj Cafe Latte Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Cafe Latte Eau De Parfum is a sweet gourmand perfume for both women and men. Khadlaj Cafe Latte was opened in 2024. Coffee, Sweet Almond and Milk, Vanilla, Ice Cream and Amber, Vanilla, Almond Cream and Caramel are the top, middle, and base notes.

products.title: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by the house of Lattafa. It is a classy and modern scent with a nice mix of citrus, woods and spice. The perfume opens fresh with lemon, bergamot, clary sage and juniper berries, giving a cool and clean feeling. As it settles, white tea, sandalwood, cardamom and olibanum bring warmth and smoothness. The dry down has ambergris, cedarwood, cashmeran and patchouli that make it deep, cozy, and long-lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance with a smooth and elegant oriental vanilla scent. Launched in 2021, it opens with fresh and spicy top notes of pink pepper and bergamot, followed by the floral heart of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, and jasmine. The base is rich and warm with agarwood (oud), amber, and vanilla.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, unisex scent. Launched in 2023, it is a dessert style fragrance profile made with pistachio, ice cream, bergamot, hazelnut, cardamom and rum (top notes); pear, jasmine, peony, geranium, raspberry and white peach (heart notes) and whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, tonka bean and cedarwood (base notes) blended softly into a playful and smooth composition with gourmand sweetness and fruity floral touch that feels cozy and addictive.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Untold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Untold Eau de Parfum is a bold unisex fragrance which wash launched in 2022 It is a combination of saffron and jasmine which are its top notes and followed by warm amberwood and ambergris in the middle notes and in the base notes with deep fir resin and cedar. The perfume carries a strong and long- lasting scent profile that makes it a favourite among fragrance lovers who enjoy a powerful yet smooth mix of spicy, woody and amber notes.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is a classy, warm, and spicy fragrance designed for men who love to stand out. This perfume brings together rich woody notes, fresh spices, and smooth amber to create a bold yet inviting scent.

Launched in 2023, Afnan Turathi Brown smells modern but carries a timeless touch. With every spray, you get a burst of fresh spices, warm amber, and smooth vanilla that lasts all day. It’s perfect for men who want to feel confident and elegant, whether it’s for daily wear or special evenings.

If you enjoy strong, warm perfumes that leave a lasting impression wherever you go, Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is worth trying.

products.title: Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum is a classy and modern men’s perfume from the house of Ajmal. It is made for men who like clean, elegant and confident scents. The fragrance opens fresh and spicy with neroli and pepper, giving a sharp and bright start. The heart feels smooth and warm with orris root, amber and geranium, which adds softness and depth. The base settles into woody tones of cedar and patchouli, making the scent masculine and long lasting. Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum is perfect for daily wear, office use and evening outings without feeling heavy or loud.

products.title: Lattafa Hayati Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Hayati Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and smooth unisex perfume made for people who love a classy yet modern scent. The opening part is bright and fruity due to the juicy scent of apple and bergamot. Then the heart warms us with the spiciness of cinnamon and woody notes, thus giving us depth and comfort. At last, the base composed of musk and vanilla delivers a smooth and creamy finish that is long-lasting, elegant and beautiful all day long.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum is a creamy, warm and bold unisex perfume from the house of Lattafa. It has a strong oriental style with sweet spices, deep woods, soft leather and smoky oud. The opening is spicy with cinnamon, cardamom, and bergamot. The heart has saffron, sandalwood, cedar and carnation, giving a warm and creamy feel. The dry down becomes sweet, woody and slightly smoky with oud, vanilla, leather and amber.

products.title: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum is an intense and warm men's fragrance that is characterized by spicy, sweet, and woody notes. The beginning is a very fresh and bold combination of mandarin, lemon, and spicy pepper that is very vigorous. Gradually, the aroma gets softer with delicate blossoms and wood. Eventually, a heavier, warm feeling is produced by the vanilla, tonka bean, and sandalwood in the base. This fragrance emanates power, self-assuredness, and is spot-on for today’s men.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum is a creamy and warm unisex perfume made for people who love deep oriental scents. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels luxurious and strong but still smooth. It opens with fresh citrus and spicy notes, then slowly moves into a warm heart of amber, patchouli and oud. The dry down is creamy and soft with vanilla, sandalwood and white musk, which stays close to skin and feels very elegant.

products.title: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum is a bold, woody, spicy perfume for men who like strong yet smooth perfumes. It opens with a warm, spicy blend of nutmeg, clove and lemon that feels fresh yet deep. The middle has a soft, creamy touch of milk blended with rose and davana, offering a slightly sweet, smooth texture. The base settles into creamy notes of amber, patchouli, frankincense and labdanum that feel warm, resinous and long lasting.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Pacific Chill Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Pacific Chill Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bright unisex scent made for people who enjoy clean, fruity and calming smells. It opens with a cool mix of mint, lemon, orange and black currant that feels like a fresh morning breeze near the sea. The heart has a soft blend of apricot, basil, carrot seed and rose, giving it a gentle and natural vibe. The base settles nicely with fig, dates, and ambrette, making the scent warm, smooth and slightly sweet in a simple, easy way.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau De Parfum is a warm and creamy unisex fragrance, which is smooth to the touch and a bit sweet. The introduction is a fresh combination of bergamot, orange and soft spices, which createsa bright but warm introduction. Gradually, coconut and ylang ylang blend into a rich and soothing creamy floral heart. The musk and sandalwood foundation gives the skin a rich, warm woody fragrance that lingers in the skin for many hours. This perfume is classy, contemporary and suited to those who like warm oriental perfumes with a smooth twist.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that is fresh, pure, and luminous. It is characterized by an intense citrus opening of lemon, orange, mandarin, and bergamot that is very revitalizing and vigorous. Then, the ginger gives a smooth fresh feel to the orange blossom and light marine notes, which are soft in character. The underlying tea, musk, and amber create a composed and uncomplicated fragrance that is ideal for everyday use and warm days.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum is a rich and smooth oriental floral scent made for both men and women. Launched in 2025, this perfume feels classy, warm and modern at the same time. It opens with a juicy pear mixed with fresh bergamot and a little spicy ginger, which feels bright and clean. The heart is soft and floral with orange blossom and jasmine, balanced by gentle woody notes. As it dries down, vanilla, musk and amber come together to give a warm, sweet and cozy feel.

products.title: Zimaya Tiramisu Coco Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Zimaya Tiramisu Coco Eau de Parfum is a warm and comforting fragrance. It starts with coffee and amaretto that is slightly nutty and sweet. A couple of minutes later, ice cream, biscuit and vanilla come into the picture, which makes the smell creamy and appetising. The dry down vanilla, brown sugar and amber are warm and sugary, and remain smooth on the skin.

products.title: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume from the house of Afnan which was released in 2022. It is built around a fresh and spicy DNA with sparkling citrus, spices and woody accords. The perfume starts with grapefruit, pink pepper, juniper and cardamom, all are the top notes of this perfume. The middle notes are Calabrian bergamot, cedar, nutmeg and jasmine and the final notes are ambergris, apple, musk and patchouli for a deep long-lasting impression. This fragrance is designed as a versatile everyday signature with a balance of fresh energy and warm sensuality.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Hamdan The Sheikh Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Hamdan The Sheikh Eau de Parfum consists of a warm and woody scent that is rich, smooth and elegant. This perfume was created in 2024 by House of My Perfumes. The introduction begins with bergamot, mandarin and elemi, which provides a light citrus beginning with a hint of resin. Sandalwood, amber, cedar and patchouli are eventually introduced in the heart, giving it depth and warmth. The olibanum, musk and vanilla form a creamy and faint smoky base in the dry down of the tonka bean, which remains for many hours on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Suqraat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Suqraat Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and slightly spicy men’s perfume from the house of Lattafa. It opens with bright bergamot and warm ginger, then moves into soft lavender and green violet leaf. The scent finishes with smooth musk, creamy sandalwood and a hint of warm amber.

products.title: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a bold and heavy unisex scent known for its rich, smoky and sweet spicy style. It starts loud with warm cinnamon, oud, incense, saffron, nutmeg and some fruity green apple and pear. Then it melts into a simple heart of patchouli and jasmine. The dry down comes strong with thick tobacco, sweet vanilla, amber, sandalwood, guaiac wood, white musk and vetiver.

products.title: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy fragrance for the modern man. The fragrance begins with the very lively and vibrant top notes of tomato leaf, rose and freesia. It then transforms into a floral and woody heart of rose, sandalwood, cedar and jasmine. Finally, it wraps up with a base that provides a rich and warm finish through the combination of leather, oud, musk, oakmoss and amber.

products.title: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum is a very masculine perfume that is rich, warm, and creamy and at the same time it is classy and bold. Its first impression comes with a spicy aroma of cardamom and saffron which has a mixed taste of sweet and sharp at the same time. Then the cardamom and saffron gradually fade away into a creamy kulfi and a floral heart which is smooth and special. The base composed of vanilla, amber, and sandalwood gives the fragrance a deep and a very long-lasting quality. This perfume is for the self-confident man who is also luxurious and wants to be perfect for extraordinary occasions.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Untamed Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Untamed Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy woody fragrance for women and men. It opens with a strong mix of cinnamon, cardamom and a little citrus touch of mandarin. After some time, it becomes sweeter with caramel and soft lavender. The base feels deep and rich with amber, woods and vetiver, giving a bold and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Prada L'homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Prada L’Homme Eau De Toilette is an inviting, subtle, and sophisticated scent for men that exudes freshness and class. It starts off with a gentle and bright soft blend of neroli and pepper. Gradually, the heart delivers a creamy iris and light floral note which is very clean and powdery. The warm woodiness from sandalwood, cedar, and patchouli at the base is very intimate and close to skin. This fragrance is contemporary, tranquil, and extremely corporate, thus, it is well suited for daily use.

products.title: Rayhaan Pacific Aqua Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Pacific Aqua Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean men’s fragrance. Launched in 2022, it is a bright aquatic style scent built around citrus and aromatic notes. The opening feels crisp and lively with bergamot, lemon, tangerine and cardamom. The middle brings soft herbal freshness from lavender and cypress. The base of Rayhaan Pacific Aqua Eau de Parfum settles into warm amber, giving the scent a smooth finish.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Legacy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Legacy Eau de Parfum is a clean, sharp and confident fresh and powerful men's fragrance. The initial spray is a fresh burst of citrus with a twist of lime and grapefruit, combined with cool mint and gentle lavender. Eventually black pepper and rosemary begin to appear spicy. It has a long-lasting and contemporary masculine smell because the base is made woody and smooth with ambroxan, vetiver and tonka bean.

products.title: Nusuk Raheeq Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Raheeq Extrait de Parfum is a creamy, sweet, warm perfume made for both men and women. It opens with juicy and honey like notes of honey, blood orange, apricot and lemon, which give a fruity, sweet start. The heart comes creamy and tasty with coconut, caramel and soft magnolia. The dry down feels smooth and cozy with vanilla absolute, musk and sandalwood.

products.title: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum is a bold, masculine scent. Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum was released in 2023 and carries a dark, warm profile built around chestnut, spices and elemi in the opening; aromatic sage in the middle and a deep base of vanilla, leather and oud. The mixture feels creamy, slightly sweet and smoky with a strong leather tone that gives a classy yet powerful vibe.

products.title: Louis Vuitton L'Immensite Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton L’Immensité Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean men’s perfume made for daily wear. It opens with bright citrus and ginger that feels cool and light on the skin. Then the scent moves into watery and herbal notes like rosemary, sage and soft geranium. The dry down turns warm and comforting with ambroxan, amber and a bit of labdanum, giving a soft skin-like finish.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana The One Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana The One Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a classic and men’s scent that mixes warm, spicy and woody notes into one elegant blend. It opens with fresh grapefruit, coriander and basil that feel clean and confident. The heart brings spicy touches of cardamom, ginger and a hint of orange blossom. The dry down is smooth and deep with amber, tobacco and cedar giving it a warm, masculine finish. It’s a perfect perfume for men who love a classy, charming scent that lasts through the day.

products.title: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum is a bright and citrus scent crafted for women who love sweet, creamy and sparkling fragrances which is launched in 2025 it brings together a combination of zesty lemon and bergamot with smooth vanilla and white flowers at the opening. The middle shines with notes of rum, sugar, orange blossom, honey and whipped cream giving it a delicious dessert like feel. The final notes are caramel, tonka, musk and creamy vanilla wrapping the scent into a long-lasting sweet trail that feels both joyful and addictive.

products.title: Riiffs Wonder of Your Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Wonder of Your Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy and slightly sweet scent from Riiffs house. It is a men’s perfume for those who like strong yet smooth scents that make them feel stylish and confident. The scent opens spicy and warm with chestnut, pink pepper and clove, then becomes soft and aromatic with sage and light amber and finally settles into a creamy, sweet base of tonka bean and vanilla.

products.title: Lattafa Fakhar Gold Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Fakhar Gold Extrait De Parfum is a rich and classy perfume for men from the famous house of Lattafa. It opens with a bright, spicy touch of grapefruit, pink pepper and cardamom. The middle mixes soft tuberose with warm solar notes and herbal artemisia. The dry down is deep and comforting, filled with amber, leather, labdanum and smooth cashmeran.

products.title: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum is a lavish, warm, and sweet fragrance suitable for both genders. The perfume starts with a bold tobacco leaf aroma blended with gentle spices that provide a luxurious and sophisticated feel. After a while, the creamy vanilla, cacao, and tonka bean add sweetness and smoothness to the scent. The woody and dried fruit notes remain on the skin for an extended period in the dry-down stage. This perfume exudes luxury, and daring, and is just right for those who appreciate the strong and warm scents.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Universe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Universe is a new female and male citrus aromatic perfume. This is a new fragrance. The Art of Universe was introduced in 2025. The aroma starts with fresh mandarin, bergamot, mint and a spicy touch of ginger. Pear and orange blossom are used in the heart to add some soft sweetness and smoothness. Musk, amber and cedar base provide a warm woody finish which remains well-behaved on the skin hours later.

products.title: Khadlaj Karus Secret Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Karus Secret Musk Eau de Parfum is a warm and sweet unisex perfume that is smooth and slightly creamy. It begins with a sweet spicy saffron and juicy red fruits then gradually switches to a rich tonka bean, rose and chocolate heart that is warm and deep. The musky and amber base remains on the skin for long hours with a soft and noticeable mark. It is contemporary, daring and somewhat addictive.

products.title: Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Issey Miyake L’Eau D’Issey Pour Homme is a fresh, clean, and uplifting perfume for men with a gentle woody touch. It opens with bright citrus notes like yuzu, lemon, mandarin and bergamot that feel very crisp and refreshing. The middle brings a combination of spicy nutmeg, saffron, cinnamon and soft florals like blue lotus and lily-of-the-valley that give a smooth balance. As it dries down, it turns warm, woody and a bit musky with vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, amber and a soft tobacco note. It is a timeless, everyday fragrance that feels light, natural and very easy to wear.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Elite Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Elite Eau De Parfum is a classy and confident men’s scent that speaks style and strength. It was launched in 2016 by Alfred Dunhill, a brand known for luxury and refinement. The fragrance opens with fresh and bright top notes of cardamom, bitter orange, bergamot and lime. In the middle, the warm heart reveals vetiver, black pepper, blue sage and juniper which give a spicy and clean charm. The dry down is smooth with base notes of ebony, sandalwood, suede and labdanum giving it a deep and masculine finish.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. Launched in 2023, it opens with a juicy and fruity burst of grapefruit, tangerine, strawberry and pineapple. The middle notes is floral with jasmine, orchid, peony and a touch of vanilla. Finally, it develops into a warm and luxurious base of oakmoss, musk and woody notes, leaving a smooth and lasting scent suitable for all events.

products.title: Nusuk Sama Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Sama Eau de Parfum is a fresh and airy unisex perfume from the house of Nusuk. It was introduced in 2025 and has a light, cool and refreshing clean aquatic style. The fragrance begins with the fresh and luminous scent of lemon and bergamot. Heart mixes sage, geranium and ozonic notes, which are breezy and herbal to some extent. The base settles into soft moss, musk and light amber, creating a smooth and relaxing finish that stays gentle on skin and pleasant in the air.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Enigma of Taif Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Enigma of Taif Extrait de Parfum is a creamy and deep scent built around the beauty of the Taif rose. It opens slightly spicy and fruity, giving a warm and interesting start. As it settles, the middle becomes more floral with soft sweetness from rose and saffron. The base feels woody, resinous, and smooth, making the fragrance feel luxurious and long lasting. Swiss Arabian Enigma of Taif Extrait de Parfum has a strong Middle Eastern touch but still feels modern and wearable.

products.title: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum is a new unisex floral scent from Nusuk Fragrances. Released in 2025, it offers a soft, fruity floral style, with light smoky and musky tones. The opening starts with incense, fennel, and sweet red fruits, giving a slightly warm and juicy feel. The heart blooms with peach, osmanthus and jasmine, which smells smooth and floral. The base settles into sandalwood, rose, and musk that feels creamy, gentle and long lasting on skin.

products.title: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. It combines fresh, floral and woody notes that are very pleasant and have a long-lasting effect at the same time. The perfume starts with fruity and soft floral notes of apple, litchi and rose, which make a sweet and bright opening. As it develops, the heart reveals plum and jasmine that add a creamy floral depth. The base brings warm notes of moss, vanilla and patchouli, leaving a rich, elegant trail that remains for hours.

products.title: Lattafa Nebras Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nebras Elixir by Lattafa is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Nebras Elixir was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Nanako Ogi. Top notes are Milk Candy and Whipped Cream; middle notes are Sugar Cane and Heliotrope; base notes are Vanilla, Ambroxan and Musk.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume from the house of Swiss Arabian. The perfume has a very deep Middle Eastern oud style with a slight and soft sweet note. The opening of the fragrance is that of warm saffron, then the main note of strong oud and rose takes over and finally a very rich and creamy base of praline, vanilla and oud.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum is a deep, warm and bold unisex scent from the house of Lattafa. It mixes smoky incense, rich leather, strong oud, warm amber and soft musk into a thick, dark cloud of sweet, smoky woods. The scent opens with a hint of citrus that feels bright for a few seconds but quickly melts into spicy cinnamon, heavy oud, and warm amber. It is known for its dark and powerful aura, making it a perfect pick for people who love strong Arabic-style perfumes.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux I Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: The Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux I Extrait de Parfum is a vibrant and strong perfume suitable for both genders. The perfume has a very fruity, fresh and lively opening of pineapple, lemon and bergamot, mixed with a delicate sweetness of caramel. Gradually it transforms to a woody and mild spicy smell, and finally it is deep, warm, and smooth with amber, leather and vanilla. The fragrance has an aura of elegance, daring, and persistence.

products.title: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum is a new fragrance for men and women released in 2024. It is a sweet, warm fragrance that feels playful at first and then turns rich and deep as it settles. It opens with caramel, apricot, almond and a little pink pepper spark. In the heart you get honey, soft white flowers, rose and a touch of rhubarb. The base is warm and cozy with leather, vanilla, labdanum, musk and vetiver.

products.title: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich oriental floral perfume designed for women who love warm and sweet scents. The perfume opens with a soft and fruity mixture of Mandarin Orange and Pear, then the heart of Jasmine, Rose, and sweet notes wrap the fragrance giving it a smooth and creamy touch. The base is Vanilla, Musk, and Raspberry that impart a warm sweetness which is very beautifully intimate with the skin.

products.title: French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum from French Avenue Fragrances is a fresh, bright and easy to wear perfume for women who enjoy clean, fruity scents. This perfume was introduced in 2024 and starts with sticky sweet citrus that is fresh and joyful. The heart adds a soft green, fruity touch, while the base settles into a smooth, musky finish. French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum feels light, modern and perfect for daily wear without being heavy or loud.

products.title: French Avenue Zenith Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Zenith Blue Eau de Parfum is French Avenue's take on Dior Sauvage EDT, built on the same fresh-peppery, ambroxan-heavy blueprint. The real selling point: it's composed by Jean-Louis Sieuzac, the nose behind Fahrenheit and Kouros. Not a generic lab copy. Clean and sharp, more functional than flashy. Works year-round, leans daytime, and fits comfortably in an office rotation.
