products.title: French Avenue Royal Blend Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Royal Blend Eau de Parfum is a creamy and smooth unisex fragrance launched in 2023. It opens with a bold mix of cognac, cinnamon and plum that feels deep and slightly sweet. The heart brings soft iris with smoky myrrh, giving the perfume a calm and royal touch. When it settles, vanilla, tonka and sandalwood form a creamy and woody base that lingers near the skin and is highly elegant. French Avenue Royal Blend Eau de Parfum is ideal if you prefer comfortable, luxurious and contemporary perfumes which seem luxurious but not too loud.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Muzn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Muzn is a unisex fruity-aquatic Eau de Parfum from the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house. It is a vibrant Middle Eastern summer captured in a blend of scents. The playful fruity notes of melon and fruits mixed with sea salt give it its iconic flavor. The musky heart with sandalwood and amber at the base gives it a smooth and lingering drydown.

products.title: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum is a warm, bright and spicy unisex scent that mixes sweet florals with fresh citrus and deep musky notes. The scent opens strong with saffron, ginger, mandarin and bergamot, giving a bold and shiny start. In the middle, you get amberwood, Moroccan rose, Egyptian jasmine and patchouli leaf that add a soft but rich touch. The dry down of vanilla, white musk, sandalwood and oakmoss makes the perfume smooth, creamy and long-lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Fire on Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fire On Ice Lattafa Perfumes is an Oriental Vanilla perfume for both men and women. This is a new fragrance. Fire On Ice was launched in 2025. Lattafa Fire On Ice Eau de Parfum is an aggressive, cozy and slightly sweet fragrance that makes the perfume feel rich immediately after spraying it. The fruity and spicy kick is brought out by the opening of cognac, raspberry and cinnamon. Some time later, soft rose petals and creamy caramel begin to appear and give it sweetness. The depth, warmth and powerful lasting power are provided by oak, myrrh, cedarwood and ambroxan in the base. It is warm, rich and comfortable to wear in the evening.

products.title: French Avenue Lumiere Garcon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Lumiere Garcon Eau de Parfum is a modern oriental fragrance made for both men and women. Launched in 2024, this scent feels warm, spicy and slightly sweet from the very first spray. It opens with fresh spice and green notes, slowly turning creamy and deep as it settles on the skin. The mix of pepper, herbs, soft fruits and smoky woods base gives it a classy yet relaxed feel.

products.title: Hermes Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Terre D’Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum is a rich, earthy, and fresh men’s fragrance that brings a deeper twist to the classic Terre d’Hermes. It opens with sharp citrus from bergamot, grapefruit, and lemon that feels bright and clean. The middle adds a spicy kick of Sichuan pepper with a soft touch of geranium. The base is warm, deep, and very earthy with strong vetiver, olibanum, patchouli, and amberwood. This scent feels elegant, powerful, and grounded, perfect for men who like a natural and mature aroma.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Fahad Gaze Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Fahad Gaze eau de perfume is a woody spicy perfume, which is bold, modern and to some extent warm. This perfume was released in 2025 and designed by a perfumer called Julia Rodriguez. The first one begins with metal tones combined with spices and elemi, which create a strong and brisk beginning. After a while, the orange blossom, patchouli and incense are introduced in the heart, giving it a rich texture with a smoky touch. The ambergris and moss in the dry down vanilla is a warm, woody base that remains on the skin over a span of many hours.

products.title: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum is a strong and dominant perfume for men with warm, fruity, and deep notes. The introduction is a pleasant fruity mix that is infused with rose and saffron to produce a smooth but slightly spicy taste. The robust oud evolves over time with patchouli and benzoin in order to establish a complex, dark atmosphere. The bottom part of the combines leather and wood materials with soft fabrics and creates a long-lasting and powerful smell that comprises vanilla and amber.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau De Parfum is a captivating, luxurious, and warm men's scent with a mellow almond top note that is mixed with spices, lavender, bergamot, rosemary, and thyme. The middle consists of cherries, vanilla, incense, and soft rose. The base note is of very leather, tonka bean, and sandalwood. This perfume is known for its sweetness-woodiness balance that has a lasting and elegant feel on the skin. It has earned a special place among the fragrance community for its powerful projection, velvety blending of different notes, and sophisticated gentlemanly vibe.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. It mixes fruity, green and warm amber notes to create a modern everyday scent. The opening feels juicy and bright with bergamot, green notes and mandarin orange. The heart becomes sweet and tropical with melon, black currant and pineapple mixed with smooth amber. The base is soft and creamy with musk, petitgrain, galbanum and vanilla, giving a long lasting finish.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum is a classy and timeless perfume for men that combines modern freshness with warm woods. Launched in 2015, it brings together citrusy top notes of neroli and bergamot, followed by a spicy core of black pepper, lavender and cardamom. The base is creamy and masculine with vetiver, oakmoss, leather, iris and oud. It’s a perfume that wraps around you a feeling of elegance, confidence and being dressed up throughout the day.

products.title: Lattafa Raaed Luxe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raaed Luxe Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and spicy fragrance for men and women that opens with juicy fruits and fresh florals. It blends watermelon, pineapple, pink pepper and jasmine at the top. The middle brings herbal notes, soft lavender, sage and a light touch of cinnamon. The dry down becomes cozy with vanilla, musk, sandalwood, chestnut, vetiver, strawberry and tonka bean.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Malibu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Malibu Eau de Parfum is a fresh aromatic fragrance made for both men and women. It was launched in 2025 as a bright, tropical twist on the Hawas line. The scent opens with juicy, fruity notes of pineapple, orange and grapefruit, giving it a fresh, lively start. In the middle, warm amber blends softly with powdery orris and clean lavender, which adds a smooth aromatic feel. The base dries down to a warm, slightly sweet blend of tonka bean, musk, patchouli and cashmeran.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance from Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2022, it is a refreshing and warm scent with a perfect summer vibe. The scent has a bright and fresh opening formed by the very top notes of saffron, mandarin orange, incense and cypriol. The fragrance then gets warmer and sweeter thanks to the middle notes of rose, cashmere wood, caramel, amber and patchouli. The skin is then treated with a long lasting, rich and smooth trail created by the base of oud, leather, musk, oakmoss and vetiver.

products.title: Rayhaan Nocturno Elixir Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Nocturno Elixir Pour Homme is Rayhaan's oriental woody take on Bleu de Chanel L'Exclusif, built around the same inky, incense-laced depth. This is the reformulated Midnight Blue version, not the discontinued burgundy bottle. Darker and more resinous, with incense woven through the mid rather than only in the base. More brooding than versatile. Best for autumn evenings, date nights, and formal occasions after sunset.

products.title: Lattafa Habik Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Habik Eau de Parfum For Men is a strong aromatic perfume, which is fresh, spicy and warm simultaneously. It starts bright with bergamot and pepper that have a sharp and clean feel. Lavender and cinnamon creep in slowly, bringing the cool comfort. During the dry down, tonka bean and sandalwood render it creamy and a little sweet. It reeks contemporary, powerful, and assertive, an ideal smell to men who appreciate audacious but refined fragrances.

products.title: Mancera  Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, more decadent version of the original Cedrat Boise. This Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum feels bolder, smoother and more long lasting on the skin. It starts with fresh citrus aromas, blended with black currant and spice, for a sharp, classy opening. Leather, sandalwood, oud, patchouli and jasmine all intertwine and combine to form a warm, rather smoky heart as it settles. It is creamy, musky at the base, contains ambergris, oakmoss, vanilla and white musk and lasts hours and hours on the skin.

products.title: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum is a stylish and modern scent made for confident men. Launched in 2024, it opens with a clean, fresh touch of Juniper Berries, Iris and Cypress, which give it a cool and classy start. The middle adds Myrrh and Patchouli which offer a smooth and deep warmth. And the base combination of Honey, Vanilla, Amber, Musk and Leather provides a strong, masculine and comforting finish.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that mixes floral, fruity and warm oriental notes. The opening consists of red berries, peach and bergamot that are very sweet and juicy so they create a fresh and playful start. The heart reveals soft blossom of jasmine, peony and red lily. Then, the base of sandalwood, vanilla flower and musk create a creamy and warm dry-down that is become smart and long-lasting.

products.title: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum is a soft, clean and elegant unisex fragrance from the house of Ajmal Scents. This perfume is all about smooth musk blended with gentle floral and warm amber tones. It opens with a fresh and calming touch of lily of the valley, giving a clean and airy feel. As it settles, creamy musk takes over and stays close to the skin, making it comforting and classy. The warm amber and extra musk in the base contribute to the longevity of the fragrance and create a cozy feeling around it.

products.title: Montale Intense Cafe Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Intense Café Eau De Parfum is a warm, sweet and cozy unisex scent that merges smooth coffee, soft rose and creamy vanilla. It was launched in 2013 and has that calm café vibe with a touch of sweetness and a gentle musky base.

products.title: French Avenue Atlantis Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Atlantis Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, juicy and slightly creamy aquatic fragrance made for both men and women, launched in 2025. It opens with a bright mix of orange, mandarin and lemon, giving a very refreshing citrus burst. As it settles, watermelon and coconut add a sweet and watery tropical feel. In the dry down, cacao, ambergris and amberwood create a soft, warm and slightly creamy finish that stays on skin nicely.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau De Toilette is a fresh, warm, and slightly sweet men's fragrance that mixes marine notes with creamy vanilla. It opens with cool mint and soft watery notes that feel clean and refreshing. The middle brings a strong sea note, giving that salty ocean vibe. When it dries down, the vanilla and ambergris make the scent warm, inviting, and a bit sensual. It is a simple but charming everyday fragrance that many men enjoy for its freshness and comfort.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Al Noor Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Al Noor Eau de Parfum is a rich and warm fragrance that feels spicy, slightly sweet and deep. The scent opens with cardamom, nutmeg and saffron, giving a bold spicy start that quickly grabs attention. After some time, fig, iris and vetiver appear in the heart, which adds a smooth and slightly earthy feel. As it settles, leather, tonka bean, vanilla and patchouli create a warm, creamy base that stays on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Ajmal Cyan Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Cyan Oud Eau de Parfum is the Dubai-based house's fruity-musky take on Xerjoff's Erba Pura. Bright citrus up front, a juicy mango-peach middle, and a clean vanilla-musk landing. Despite the name, there is no oud here. Light, sweet, and easy to wear, it feels more like a fruit bowl than a prayer hall. Built for Indian summers, office hours, and casual daytime.

products.title: Lattafa Mashrabya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Mashrabya Eau de Parfum is a hot and sweet unisex perfume, which is deep and somewhat smoky. It starts by flavouring a fruity apple shisha touch blended with soft pink pepper, which is a very sweet beginning but a little spicy. Tobacco, cinnamon and dates are used in the middle to form a very rich and warm feel. The oud smoke, caramel, vanilla and patchouli base make it smooth, dark and long-lasting. It is daring, contemporary and fits better in cooler seasons.

products.title: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Adorn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Adorn Eau de Parfum is a smooth, modern unisex scent. It was released in 2024 and begins with a new spicy and citrus blend of pink pepper, coriander, mandarin and violet that is bright and a little sweet. The middle is a woody, earthy touch of patchouli, cedar and oakmoss, which gives it depth and richness. The base settles into warm ambergris, benzoin and vanilla, and the drydown is soft and creamy, elegant, but easy to wear every day.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau De Parfum is one of the most famous unisex perfumes in the world. It has this warm, sweet and airy aura that feels kind of glowing on the skin. The mixture of saffron, jasmine, amberwood, fir resin and cedar makes it smell rich, smooth and also a bit mysterious. It has a sweet woody smell with a little sparkle that stays on skin for long hours without feeling too heavy.

products.title: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume made for people who enjoy sweet citrus scents with a warm touch. It opens fresh and clean with lavender, bergamot and lemon, which feels bright and uplifting from the first spray. In the middle, the scent becomes soft and cozy with honey, cinnamon, jasmine and cashmeran, giving it a slightly sweet, creamy feel. The base is warm and addictive with vanilla, tobacco leaf and tonka bean.

products.title: Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm, and dreamy fragrance made for women who love to feel soft and beautiful. Launched in 2024, this perfume brings together creamy vanilla with tropical coconut and delicious caramel for a scent that feels like a warm hug. The gentle touch of Palo Santo adds a hint of calm woodiness, while the base of white musk and sandalwood gives a smooth and cozy finish.

Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is perfect for women who enjoy fragrances that are sweet yet elegant. Every spray wraps you in a blissful, creamy cloud that lasts for hours and keeps you feeling fresh and confident all day long.

products.title: Neesh Haute Tobacco Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Haute Tobacco Extrait De Parfum is a bold and rich scent made for men who like deep and strong perfumes. Initially, it reveals a fresh and fruit-like aroma of pear and apple combined with spicy pink pepper and bergamot. The warm tobacco slowly enters through the middle notes, accompanied by saffron, cardamom and soft floral notes. The base notes of amber, sandalwood, vanilla and musk create a smooth and weighty sensation on the skin, imparting a refined and long-lasting effect.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume made for oud lovers. This scent opens with spicy and floral notes that feel warm and slightly sweet. As it settles, the deep oud mixes with caramel and soft woody tones, giving a smooth and addictive feel. The base is creamy and warm with vanilla and amber, which makes the fragrance feel cozy and long lasting.

products.title: Rayhaan Cordova Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Cordova Eau de Parfum is a bold and smooth men’s fragrance. Rayhaan Cordova Eau de Parfum was launched in 2023. It carries a strong leather woody scent profile built with leather (top note), patchouli and cypress (middle notes) and amber, woody notes and vetiver (base notes).

products.title: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette is a unisex fragrance that blends fresh, floral, and woody notes to create a calm and natural vibe. Launched in 1996, it opens with a combination of lavender, citrus, and mint for a fresh start. The middle notes have soft floral and green notes like jasmine, peach, and magnolia. The base is warm and comforting with musk, sandalwood, cedar, vanilla, and amber, giving a smooth finish for everyday wear.

products.title: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum is a modern men’s perfume made for guys who like a clean, fresh and a little bit woody kind of smell. It starts with a very refreshing note of the bergamot and a gentle spicy tone. The middle notes are quite heavy due to the combination of leather and Haitian vetiver. The base contains smooth notes of ambroxan, akigalawood, patchouli leaf and a very slight touch of cacao sweetness.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum is a clean, soft, and refreshing unisex scent that feels simple yet very elegant. It opens with bright citrusy notes of bergamot and orange, giving a fresh and uplifting start. In the middle of the fragrance are vanilla and pear, which produce a very smooth and creamy sweetness and are very pleasant to smell. At last, it is the warm musk and amber in the base that make it cozy, last a long time, and are suitable for daily use.

products.title: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau de Parfum is a fresh, aquatic style scent for men who like clean, energetic fragrances. Launched in 2024, it opens with a splash of watery, citrus notes like cascalone, bergamot, aquozone and mandarin that feel bright and breezy. The heart features herbal notes of lavender, cypress and rosemary, giving it a green aromatic feel. The dry down settles into warm amber, musk and patchouli, giving smooth, masculine depth.

products.title: French Avenue Moonstone Bleu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Moonstone Bleu Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume with a cool, clean and slightly dark feel. It opens with fresh watery and metallic notes mixed with peppery spice, giving a sharp and airy start. As it settles, soft florals, beeswax and leather come in, adding smooth warmth and depth. The base feels creamy and comforting with musk, honey, woods, and amber.

products.title: Khadlaj La Fede Choco Brown Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj La Fede Choco Brown is a unisex fragrance that is rich and creamy and has a warm and sweet touch the moment it is sprayed. It starts with intense cocoa and gradually turns into creamy chocolate with pistachio and milk that creates a rather creamy dessert atmosphere. It settles into a prolonged and warm vanilla and caramel that remains intimate to the skin. This smells good, bold and ideal to the gourmand perfume lovers.

products.title: Xerjoff Naxos Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Xerjoff Naxos Eau De Parfum is a vibrant and sweet unisex scent that has the character of being warm and rich. The opening is marked by radiant lemon, bergamot, and lavender notes that are both fresh and spirited. The creamy, warm, and sugary heart created by honey, cinnamon, jasmine, and cashmeran is present in the fragrance. The soft, lingering heat produced by the combination of vanilla, tonka bean, and tobacco leaf is the foundation. This perfume has a character that is chic, contemporary, and fit for all, especially the ones who adore sweet and bold scents.

products.title: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau De Parfum is a powerful and daring leather scent that gives the impression of being luxurious, dark and elegant. The beginning of the fragrance is a little fruity with the raspberry combined with the saffron, which gives the impression of being a bit sweet and spicy. Gradually, it goes to the smoky and floral heart that feels deep and smooth. The base is all leather and suede, and it is warm, powerful, and long-lasting. This perfume is confident, mature, and luxurious, and it is ideal for bold fragrance lovers.

products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a bold and deep leather-based fragrance made for men who like strong and confident scents. It gives a slightly sweet and spicy impression from raspberry and saffron at the start, combined with a dry herbal sensation. The fragrance develops a smoky and warm character in the middle, while the base is formed of rich leather, plush suede and earthy notes with delicate amber.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum is a warm, rich and deep unisex perfume from the well-known house of Lattafa. It has a strong Middle Eastern touch with spicy, sweet and woody notes. The scent opens with a soft mix of rose, saffron and a little peppery pimento. In the middle, you get caramel, floral notes, patchouli and a beautiful oud tone that gives a dark and sweet feel. The dry down is warm with amber, resins, musk, incense and woody notes that stay long on skin and clothes.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum is a warm, deep, and cozy smell. It feels rich right from the start. It mixes the smooth sweet of caramel and raspberry with a little fresh orange. This makes a creamy, nice opening. As it sits, the perfume infuses more. You get a flowery smell of rose, violet, and jasmine. This is mixed with patchouli and a bit of incense. It gives a soft, smoky, and mysterious feel. It is creamy, cozy, and a little spicy. It rests nicely on wood, musk, and spice smells. 

Franck Olivier Oud Vanille is the kind of scent that makes you feel wrapped up in luxury. It is not too loud. But people will notice you when you walk past. It is perfect for evenings or cold days. It leaves a sweet, deep smell that stays softly. This perfume is good for both men and women. It balances sweet, spice, and sexy smells well. It is not too strong.

products.title: Riiffs Areebah Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Areebah Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume from the house of Riiffs Perfumes. It is a creamy, oriental, woody scent that feels warm, sweet and a little exotic at the same time. The scent opens with fruity and spicy tones of tropical fruits, osmanthus and saffron. The middle notes include patchouli, frangipani and agarwood, which impart a creamy, woody feel. In the dry down, you get cedar, musk and Madagascar vanilla, which makes the fragrance smooth, soft and long lasting with a cozy trail.

products.title: Riiffs Exotic Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Exotic Oud Eau de Parfum is a bold leather fragrance for men who like strong and dark scents. Launched in 2022, this perfume opens with soft floral and warm notes of geranium, amber and iris. After a few minutes, the heart comes with spicy cinnamon and a fresh citrus touch. The base is deep and smoky with leather, tobacco, spices, smoke and woody notes. Riiffs Exotic Oud Eau de Parfum feels creamy, warm and slightly sweet in the drydown.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and sweet unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy deep gourmand scents. The opening is slightly sweet with a creamy feeling coming from the soft, nutty almond note. Then, the floral notes of the Tunisian orange blossom and Turkish rose come together with the warm cinnamon in a smooth and cozy heart of the fragrance. The dry down is where the magic stays, with tonka bean, vanilla and amberwood creating a long lasting, addictive scent trail.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum was launched in 2024 as a light and breezy unisex fragrance with refreshing citrus, bergamot, and mint top notes; aromatic spices, lavender, and geranium heart notes; and soft and warm musk, woods, and amber base notes. A couple of spritz of Frose Ice EDP in the morning keeps you refreshed and energized throughout the day.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum is a creamy, sweet, and woody scent made for men who like a bold and tempting fragrance. It opens with fresh pineapple mixed with ginger and a soft hint of iris, giving it a bright yet elegant start. Then the creamy coconut blends with deep wood notes, making the scent warm and slightly tropical. The base is smooth and sensual with tonka bean, sandalwood, amber, and ambergris. It feels sweet, masculine, addictive, and lasts well on skin, perfect for nights out and cooler days.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum is a rich and deep unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy bold oud scents with sweetness. It opens with a smooth honey note merged with dark agarwood, giving a warm and slightly sweet start. The middle contains spicy cinnamon entwined with rich, creamy vanilla and amber, which is pleasant and comforting. The base comprises patchouli and leather, creating a strong, staying Middle Eastern aura. It feels luxurious, warm and powerful, but still wearable.

products.title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum is an invigorating, sleek, and masculine perfume that radiates modernity and self-assurance. The scent starts off with a combination of icy oceanic notes, lavender and pink pepper, producing a fresh and subtly spicy introduction. The heart is very clean and has a soapy aspect due to the gentle green notes, whereas the base gets cosy and silky with the blend of musk, cashmere, and sandalwood. The fragrance is, in a way, athletic, powerful, and suited for day-to-day use.

products.title: Dunhill Indian Sandalwood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Indian Sandalwood Eau de Parfum is a classic woody fragrance for men. Launched in 2019, it opens with fresh and slightly sweet notes of carrot and bergamot (top notes); moves to a soft and earthy heart of orris and moss (middle notes); and rests on a warm, comforting base of Indian sandalwood, patchouli and cypriol oil (nagarmotha). It is a smooth, elegant scent perfect for daily wear or special occasions.

products.title: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that combines smoky woods, leather, and spices with a warm and deep oud base. This scent shows true luxury and elegance, made for men who love strong and royal perfumes. It starts fresh with grapefruit and lavender, turns deep with tobacco and leather, and finally settles into a base of oud, ambergris, and dark woods that gives a classy and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Blueberry Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Blueberry Musk Eau de Parfum is a unisex delectable, fruity and soft musky aroma. Fresh, playful, and fruity, it starts with luscious blueberry and blackberry. Gradually, among the fruity and fresh notes, come the elegant and velvety floral notes of freesia, lavender, and rose. The base has a creamy and warm feel of vanilla, raspberry and soft woods. This perfume is characterized by its cosiness, modernity and daily wearability.

products.title: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum is a creamy, bold and classy scent for both men and women. It mixes fresh citrus and spicy notes with a warm woody base that makes it perfect for all-day wear. The perfume presents a citrus explosion of orange and cardamom, then the sweet patchouli comes along with the hot pepper. The base notes give a thick combination of amber, cedar, vetiver and oakmoss which makes it really charming and powerful.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Vanilla Toffee Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Vanilla Toffee Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and comforting unisex fragrance made for people who love dessert style perfumes. It starts off with a powerful outburst of toffee and coffee that is melted and roasted and it gives a warm and friendly feeling. Meanwhile, the notes of vanilla and walnut, milk and dates become quite smooth and edible. The long lasting and the deep base consists of brown sugar, rich Madagascar vanilla, vanilla caviar, tonka bean, woody notes, benzoin and soft musk.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Eau De Parfum is the definition of class and sophistication in a bottle. Inspired by the iconic YSL tuxedo suit, this fragrance is for anyone who wants to feel confident, elegant, and effortlessly stylish. It perfectly blends the boldness of spicy patchouli with the warmth of smooth vanilla, creating a scent that is both powerful and comforting.

Tuxedo smells like a luxurious night out. It has a modern yet timeless charm that makes you feel polished and ready for any special occasion. It’s the perfect fragrance for those who love rich, attractive scents that draw compliments and leave a lasting memory. One spray of YSL Tuxedo wraps you in an aura of pure elegance.

products.title: French Avenue After Effect Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue After Effect Extrait De Parfum is a bold, creamy unisex fragrance for people who like strong, warm scents. It opens with a deep, boozy rum mixed with spicy cinnamon, giving a very smooth, slightly sweet feel. As French Avenue After Effect Extrait De Parfum settles, you start to get tobacco and saffron, which add warmth and a little smoky vibe. In the drydown, sandalwood and soft white flowers make the scent creamy, smooth and long lasting.

products.body_html: Ajmal Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance made for people who like fresh notes with a deep oud base. It opens with a clean and fresh mix of citrus, bergamot and mint, which feels bright and energetic. The middle is formed of the gentle flowers and the warm spices of such as neroli, ginger, rose and nutmeg that give it a smooth balance. The base settles into a creamy combination of oud, amber, musk and tonka bean, thus imparting warmth, comfort and longevity to the fragrance.

products.title: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau De Parfum is an elegant men's scent that is dark, smooth, and modern. The fragrance starts off with a refreshing note of bergamot that is clean and sharp, but it later mixes with gentle angelica and deep patchouli. In the end, amber, musk, and coumarin create a dark, slightly sweet, and warm scent. This fragrance is self-assured, relaxed, and fashionable, which is why it is ideal for men who prefer classy and strong scents.

products.title: French Avenue Aromatix Platine Blanc Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aromatix Platine Blanc Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, clean and modern scent, made for daily use and special days alike. It begins very bright and sparkling, with mint, lemon and lime mixed with a fizzy tonic water feel, creating a refreshing drink. It becomes slightly green and soft in the middle, with rosemary, black currant and jasmine, creating a smooth balance. The base is warm and musky with ambergris, sandalwood and oakmoss, which stays nicely on skin and feels classy.

products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Essence Of Casablanca Extrait De Parfum is a warm, sweet and slightly fruity fragrance that feels smooth and rich on skin. It was launched in 2023 and created by perfumer Isabel Gil Trujillo. The opening gives juicy grapes and apples, which feel soft and inviting, not too sharp. Then patchouli and orris add a powdery, earthy touch. In the dry down, vanilla, amber and musk make it creamy, deep and long-lasting, giving a cosy and elegant feel.

products.title: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep unisex fragrance for those who enjoy dark, sweet and woody scents. It opens with spicy warmth from cinnamon, saffron, nutmeg and ginger, which feels creamy and slightly sharp at first. As the perfume settles, you start getting heavy oud, incense, dates, caramel and amberwood notes that feel sweet, smoky and resin like. In the dry down, leather, vanilla, cacao butter, musk and patchouli come together to give a creamy, warm and long lasting base that feels luxurious and strong.

products.title: Nautica Voyage N 83 Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage N-83 Eau de Toilette is a fresh aquatic scent for men from the house of Nautica. It is inspired by ocean breezes and cool sea air, giving a clean sporty vibe. The scent opens with fresh sea notes, peppermint and petitgrain, moves into a soft, spicy heart of lavender, cardamom and nutmeg and settles into a smooth base of musk, cedar and sandalwood. The blend feels fresh, slightly spicy and woody at the same time, making it a very easy everyday men’s perfume for those who like clean marine scents.

products.title: Byredo Bal D'afrique Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum is a warm and elegant unisex fragrance inspired by African culture and Parisian spirit. Launched in 2009, this scent beautifully combines citrus, floral, and woody notes in a smooth balance. It opens with fresh Amalfi lemon, marigold, bergamot, black currant, and African orange flower. The middle notes of violet, cyclamen, and jasmine give it a soft floral charm, while the base of vetiver, musk, amber, and Virginia cedar adds depth and long-lasting warmth.

products.title: French Avenue Veneno Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Veneno Eau de Parfum is an ambitious and innovative perfume, designed to attract both men and women. It starts with a fresh and juicy apple aroma with smoky and spicy cinnamon that is quite enticing. Tobacco and moss make it sink into the earth as it sinks. Bourbon vanilla and orcanox base are what provide a feeling of warmth and sweetness to be long-lasting on the skin. This perfume is powerful, elegant and suitable with the self assured individuals.

products.title: Diptyque Orpheon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is a classy, modern unisex fragrance that feels warm, cozy, and stylish all at once. Inspired by the lively nights of Paris in the 1960s, Orphéon evokes memories of jazz bars, wooden furniture, and powdery notes reminiscent of soft skin and warm drinks.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh, slightly spicy touch of juniper berries, which feels crisp and clean. The heart of jasmine adds a gentle floral note that balances beautifully with the warm base of powder, cedarwood, and smooth tonka bean.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love fragrances that feel both fresh and comforting. This perfume feels like wearing a stylish blazer with a soft scarf, easy, elegant, and always inviting.

products.title: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette is a fresh unisex fragrance from the house of Calvin Klein. Launched in 2017, it carries the modern spirit of youth and freedom with a clean citrus profile. The perfume opens with a burst of bergamot, mandarin orange, and grapefruit blossom giving a bright and zesty start. The heart notes bring out jasmine, rhubarb, freesia, and lily adding a soft floral touch with a hint of green freshness. Finally, the dry down settles into warm and smooth notes of musk, amber, and vetiver, making it a balanced scent that feels both uplifting and comforting.

products.title: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Green Irish Tweed EDT for men was launched in 1985 in France by Creed Boutique—a renowned fragrance house in high society. It is a fine blend of fresh green aromas that adds a timeless, sophisticated, and charismatic gentleman vibe to the masculine energy. It gives a clean and polished depth with its aromatic fougère DNA and soft natural notes of iris, vervain, violet leaves, amber, and sandalwood.

products.title: Le Labo Santal 33 Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Santal 33 Eau De Parfum is a warm, dry and smoky unisex scent that has become a modern classic since its launch. It blends creamy sandalwood, soft leather, papyrus, cardamom spice and clean woods like cedar to create a calm, earthy smell that feels simple but very addictive. The mix also has violet and iris, giving a smooth, soft touch in the heart, while amber adds a little warm glow in the base.

products.title: Khadlaj Mansion Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Mansion Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that combines sweet and rich and slightly alcoholic notes, which was introduced to the market in 2025. The scent begins with cognac warmth that blends raspberry sweetness and nutty elements to create an exceptional initial scent. The perfume develops into its middle stage when tonka bean and violet, myrrh and rose perfumes create a combination of intense and delicate scents. The perfume lasts its entire duration through a dry down which combines caramel and praline and sandalwood and oakmoss to produce a creamy sweet scent that endures.

products.title: Lattafa Eclaire Pistache Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Eclaire Pistache Eau de Parfum is a creamy, nutty and very sweet gourmand fragrance made for both men and women, launched in 2025. It opens with rich pistachio and pistachio spread cream, giving a smooth and dessert-like start which feels very unique. As it settles, cacao, whipped cream and coconut add a soft, milky sweetness. In the dry down, vanilla, milk and musk create a warm, cosy, and long-lasting finish that feels like a creamy treat.

products.title: French Avenue Aromatix Forbidden Fruit Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aromatix Forbidden Fruit Extrait de Parfum is a rich and fruity oriental floral fragrance for men and women that feels sweet, juicy and slightly warm. It was launched in 2025 by Aromatix X French Avenue. The opening is bright and fresh with blood orange, bergamot and a hint of cardamom, giving a juicy citrus start. Then slowly red apple, peach and rose come in with a soft margarita twist, which makes it playful and sweet. The base of vanilla, amber and woods gives a creamy, warm and long-lasting finish that stays on skin for hours.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Eau de Parfum is a bold, deep oriental woody perfume for men who like a strong presence. It opens with spicy, fresh notes of pink pepper, clary sage and saffron. The middle brings smooth ambroxan and dry cedar wood, which gives it a clean woody feel. The base is warm and long lasting with white musk, patchouli, amber and guaiac wood.

products.title: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum is a prosperous and bold men's perfume from the house of Rabanne. It launched in 2023 and is a deep, warm scent made with spicy, woody and leathery notes that feel royal and strong. It begins spicy and fresh using saffron, nutmeg, black pepper and bergamot. The middle is a smooth mixture of woody patchouli, gurjan balsam and sandalwood. The base is dark, warm and long lasting, using oud, leather, cedarwood and labdanum.

products.title: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and creamy scent for both men and women. Starting with a golden soft and sweet mix of caramel and saffron, the heart contains suede, leather and tonka bean which smooth out the scent and give it depth. The vanilla, amber and musk in the base provide a long-lasting warm and pleasant trail.

products.title: Lattafa Ramz Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ramz Gold Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and fruity scent that feels both bright and soft. It starts off with an explosion of fruits like a crunchy apple, juicy peach, tangy blackcurrant, sweet pear and zesty orange. The floral heart consists of rose, jasmine and orange blossom which not only imparts a fresh quality but also smooths the scent. The base is a mix of milk and warmth with sandalwood, white musk, vanilla and patchouli.

products.title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Sandalwood Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Sandalwood started as a UAE-exclusive, never officially sold in Western markets. That grey-market scarcity built a quiet cult following online. The sandalwood is dry and resinous, grounded by saffron and vanilla without tipping into gourmand territory. Warm but not cloying. Best for fall evenings, winter date nights, and cooler weather after dark.

That extra concentration shows up in the base, where red amber and guaiac wood give it a warm anchor that lighter aquatics lose after an hour. Fresh but not thin. Best for office days, casual outings, and anywhere air conditioning is doing the heavy lifting.

The base of patchouli and amber provides a warm, smooth finish that stays nicely on the skin. Hawas Verde feels modern, fresh and easy to wear for daily use.

It opens with a warm, slightly fruity note from dates, mixed with soft spices like saffron and nutmeg. As it settles, it becomes creamy and sweet, with notes of vanilla and praline, giving a smooth, dessert like vibe. In the drydown, you get a deep, warm base of tonka bean, amberwood, benzoin and musk, which feels cozy, strong and long lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Al Qiam Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Qiam Eau de Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that feels clean, woody, and modern. It opens with a burst of grapefruit and ginger, which gives a bright and spicy freshness. After that, the heart of the perfume is made by ambroxan and sandalwood, giving a slightly warm and soft woody smell. The base consists of musk and vetiver, which produce a warm and earthy dry down that is very close to your skin. It is fresh but deep, ideal for everyday use or special occasions.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum is an affordable, luxurious, and unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. It is an interesting take on modern citrusy and crispy fruity notes of lemon and apple with warmer and heavier leather, patchouli, amber, and musk with a bit of nature-based accords of lily of the valley and oakmoss.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Musk Eau de Parfum is a soft and clean unisex perfume that feels calm, smooth and cozy on skin. It starts off with white musk and a light touch of black tea, giving a fresh but warm start. The heart is a mixture of iris, which is powdery and sweet vanilla. The base consists of cedarwood, amber and coumarin, which result in a soft, woody and slightly sweet base that is very close to the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau de Parfum is a bold and luxurious unisex fragrance. Introduced in 2017, it literally combines all the notes of the fresh, spicy, and warm fragrance family making the whole composition leather-centric and smooth. The fruity and spicy mix of juniper berries, cardamom, pink pepper, and raspberry marks up the top notes. The middle has the floral and slightly hot scent of iris, ginger, and rose. The bottom or base note is composed of a combination of leather, white musk, and amber, which are rich and sensual thus leaving a long-lasting impression.

products.title: Khadlaj Nafais Sharq Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Nafais Sharq Eau De Parfum is a creamy, soft and slightly sweet perfume that is designed to be worn by both men and women, that started being sold in the 2020s. It starts with a floral start of gardenia, vanilla and apricot that is sweet. When it settles, pear and freesia bring about a fresh fruity touch with a light woody sense. Bourbon vanilla, musk and amber are used in the dry down to provide a warm and cozy finish that is long lasting.

products.title: Rayhaan Imperia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Imperia Eau de Parfum is a fresh, woody aromatic men’s perfume for those who like clean yet bold fragrances. It opens with a lively mix of bergamot, apple, mint and elemi, offering a fresh, slightly sweet start. The middle notes of patchouli, jasmine, rose and sandalwood add a soft, woody, floral touch. In the dry down, cedar, oakmoss, amber and musk blend smoothly to create a warm, masculine base that feels classy and long lasting.

products.title: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy men’s perfume who like bold and fresh smell. It opens with a bright citrus touch of bergamot and lemon with soft elemi. The middle notes create a woody and floral landscape with lily of the valley and jasmine, which is creamy and clean at the same time. The base is warm and long lasting with musk, patchouli and amber that stays on the skin.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Cranberry Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Cranberry Musk Eau de Parfum is a very gentle, fresh, and somewhat sweet perfume among others made for women and men at the same time. First on your skin is a pleasant mix of cranberry, lotus, and freesia that is light and refreshing. After a while, the fragrance becomes creamy and silky with musk, pear, and jasmine in the core. During the last phase, sandalwood and vanilla contribute a warm and soft feeling. This perfume emits a serene, pure, and contemporary aura thus making it suitable for everyday use.

products.title: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau De Parfum was launched in 2017 by Ajmal fragrance house based in UAE as a woody floral musk scent with a citric opening and a musky drydown. Alongside the zesty lime and bergamot notes, the opening is adorned with melon sweetness, the heart speaks of floral lily and jasmine while dancing in a musk wind; and the drydown is like a sunset- soft and satisfying with pleasant woody notes of amber, oud patchouli and cedar.

products.title: Maison Crivelli Oud Maracuja Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Crivelli Oud Maracuja Extrait De Parfum is a bold and unique fragrance launched in 2023. It is made for both women and men who like something different and strong. The scent opens with a mix of passionfruit and saffron, giving a fruity yet slightly spicy feel. Then oud and patchouli come in, adding depth and richness. In the dry down, leather, amber and vanilla create a dark, warm and long-lasting finish that stays close but noticeable.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco is a men-oriented Oriental Spicy fragrance. It was launched in 2024. This aroma begins with pink pepper, black pepper, cardamom, elemi and sage which creates an impression of freshness and spiciness. Tobacco in the heart is combined with chestnut, cinnamon leaf and a touch of soft chili, which adds flavor and a warmness. It is smooth, sweet and long-lasting on the body, with the help of the base of bourbon vanilla, amber, guaiac wood and benzoin.

products.title: Ajmal Avid Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: This perfume has a highly intense fragrance that attracts the young, suave male audience. The fragrance pools a wide range of fresh and heartening notes. The top notes carry fresh and fruity tones, merging into a woody aquatic heart that exudes an enlivening effect on the wearer. The top and heart culminate into a fascinating base, full of warm amber and patchouli to make the creation cast its charm.

products.title: French Avenue Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum French Avenue is a fresh, fruitful and a bit warm perfume that is produced to suit both men and women. It opens with fat juicy black currant and blackberry with a fresh tint of bergamot and rosemary which feels good and cheerful. The vodka and raspberry are used in the middle with a sweet and smooth finish with a gentle floral touch. The fragrance is long lasting as the base is comfortable and full of musk, sandalwood, and amber.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum is a rich and warm scent made for men who like deep and classy fragrances. It is a new release from the famous Al Haramain house in 2024. The perfume opens with spicy saffron, fresh bergamot and soft elemi. The heart carries strong agarwood with elegant Bulgarian rose and gentle lily of the valley. The base settles into sweet tonka bean, warm amber, clean white musk and earthy oakmoss.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdijan Grand Soir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Grand Soir Eau de Parfum is a creamy, warm and elegant unisex perfume launched in 2016 by the luxury French perfume house Maison Francis Kurkdjian. It opens with a smooth mix of Spanish labdanum and a light touch of orange, which feels warm and slightly sweet. The heart brings lavender and Siam benzoin, which add a calm, resin like depth. The base is deep and comforting with amber, vanilla, tonka bean, musk and cedar, giving the perfume its signature long lasting warmth.

products.title: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum is a warm, rich and sweet oriental scent made for both men and women. It combines bold spices with deep woods and smooth sweetness. The very beginning gives us saffron and bergamot, which form a brilliant start with a bit of spice. The heart is, of course, very powerful with oud and Bulgarian rose. Finally, the dry down is very warm and cozy with tonka bean, sugar cane, amber, white musk and oakmoss.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette is a soft and clean perfume that smells like fresh sheets, warm sunlight and a slow, cozy morning. It is a soft and unisex aroma made up of lighthearted flowers, a little bit of pear, soft rose and iris in the middle and a velvety warm base of white musk, ambrette and a whisper of patchouli leaf.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey Go Mango Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey Go Mango Eau de Parfum is a fresh and fruity scent with a soft oriental touch. It is a new launch from Armaf, made for people who enjoy sweet, juicy, and slightly warm perfumes. The fragrance begins with fresh citrus and spicy notes of lemon, pink pepper and ginger, with tender white flowers. Next comes the middle, with mango adding a juicy, creamy texture, mixed with tonka bean and dry, woody notes. During the drydown, it becomes warm and smooth, with vanilla, amber, musk, guaiac wood and a slight nutty sweetness.

The base of sandalwood makes it smooth, creamy, and long-lasting with a classy feel.

products.title: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum is a dark, bold and smoky leather men’s perfume made for those who like strong scents. It was launched in 2023 and opens with incense, gaiac wood and saffron, which feels warm and mysterious. The middle brings leather with a soft, sweet touch from violet and sugar cane. The base is deep and smoky with patchouli, sandalwood, woods and black musk that stays long on skin. Overall, French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum feels powerful, mature and very confident.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum is a bold unisex perfume made for those who love creamy and deep scents. It starts with a warm mix of saffron, lavender and fresh Italian mandarin that brings brightness and spice together. The heart opens with amberwood, cedar and geranium giving it a woody and slightly floral feel. The base of akigalawood, incense and labdanum adds smoky warmth that stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold, and luxurious unisex fragrance that blends rich spices with smooth oud and sweet undertones. Launched in 2021, Supremacy in Oud quickly became popular for its exotic vibe and modern twist on classic oriental scents.

The first spray of Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum brings a burst of spicy saffron and nutmeg, balanced with calming lavender. The heart reveals deep agarwood (oud) mixed with sweet notes that add a smooth, comforting layer. The dry down is warm and long-lasting with earthy patchouli and soft musk, giving this perfume a rich, lasting finish.

Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love powerful, spicy, and woody scents that make them stand out wherever they go.

products.title: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum is an oriental fragrance available for women and men. It was released in 2016 and developed by perfumer Aurélien Guichard. This fragrance begins with the notes of frankincense, raspberry, saffron and pear that are a bombard of smoky and sweet sweetness. Damask rose, musk and orange blossom, agarwood (oud) and leather with patchouli and ambergris are reported to be the damask rose, the base, and the other, respectively. It is courageous, intense and highly opulent to the skin.
